submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G3 with a 1 mm gas gap. Among the candidates with known environmental data, Mixture-G3 has the lowest GWP100 value (15) and satisfies the GWP hard limit of 150; Mixture-G2 is excluded because its GWP100 is 1400. The selected 1 mm gap is within the allowed 1–3 mm range and is the smallest permitted gap, which is the conservative choice for pursuing the best timing performance. However, no timing simulation document or numerical time-resolution result was available in the recorded results, so compliance with the 1.5 ns timing requirement is not verified from the provided evidence.
